description: Frozen AMBI-XQC prior versus inner XQC with outer terminal bootstrap. Only the final imagined-horizon transition uses the frozen persistent actor and OUTER ONLINE critic; earlier transitions retain native inner bootstrap and terminal entropy retains the current inner temperature. Preserve J6/N512/H3/G3/batch512 and C18/A6/T6 per real decision.

budget_source.scope: Rollout and shared update-slot budgets only; this is native XQC, not SAC.

controller.description: Seed-paired prior versus fresh inner XQC with the frozen outer actor and online critic supplying only final-horizon bootstrap targets.

prior.description: Execute the persistent actor tanh mean with no imagined work; reuse matching prior bundles from the MPPI comparison.

xqc.description: Outer-terminal XQC: execute the adapted actor tanh mean after J6/N512/H3/G3/batch512. Use the frozen outer actor and online outer critic only for final imagined-horizon bootstrap, retaining the current inner alpha on its entropy term. Earlier bootstrap, learning rates and frozen reward scale retain checkpoint XQC semantics.
